content: Supabase RBAC via a public.profiles table joined to auth.users, with RLS policies referencing role/permission columns. Two approaches: (a) store role in JWT app_metadata via a custom Access Token Hook and read via auth.jwt()->>'role' in policies (avoids per-row DB lookup but adds Auth Hook complexity -- CLAUDE.md explicitly rules this out for this project's 2-role/3-boolean scale); (b) query the profiles table directly from the policy. Option (b) is simpler and matches CLAUDE.md's mandated pattern, but requires a SECURITY DEFINER function to avoid infinite recursion (see recursion pitfall).
